integrations.name: GitHub CLI/API
writeCapabilities: pull request or issue mutation only with explicit approval
secretSafeRules: Never print or persist token values
Never put credentials in PR text, prompts, THINK, or DTHINK

integrations.name: Neon Postgres and pgvector
writeCapabilities: application writes only in explicitly authorized tests
migration execution only with explicit approval
secretSafeRules: Never print DATABASE_URL or provider API values
Use the shared pg pool and bounded timeouts
Missing DATABASE_URL or NEON_API_KEY is an explicit optional skip

integrations.name: Upstash Redis MCP
writeCapabilities: only explicitly approved bounded operational Redis commands
secretSafeRules: Redis MCP is not a credential vault
Never search for or store secret values
Do not run destructive or unbounded commands during verification

integrations.name: Upstash Box SDK
readCapabilities: health and console evidence when provisioned
writeCapabilities: staging browser actions only with explicit approval
secretSafeRules: Missing Box credentials are an explicit optional skip
Never print or persist the Box key
Do not claim browser evidence when Box is unavailable
